# Phase pairing regression crops

Small grayscale channel crops from the local 2026-10-02 90/20 and 100/20 repeat campaigns. No hardware access is needed. Crops preserve original pixel intensity and equal x/y geometry.

109, 121, 129 reproduce centre-profile merging across a carrier gap. The new conservative transverse branch resolves separate candidates; precise endpoint accuracy is still subject to visual review. 188 reproduces an unsupported 151 px jump after a roughly 40 px train; it is unresolved, not proof of no formation. 190, 195 and 425 exercise abstention on transition/continuous-phase images. Expected empty results must never be used as physical absence labels by themselves.
